prompt_verbatim: Create ONE whole-body 2D pixel-art animation in-between of Ultraman Type C, side view, head right. Reference 1 is the earlier pose and reference 2 the later pose: the hips remain nearly fixed while BOTH complete thighs swing upward and backward toward the left around the hip. Draw a genuine intermediate angular pose, not a copy of either: the near knee must be left and clearly below the pelvis, the far knee farther left and only slightly below the pelvis, not above it. The calves bend left and down, feet follow naturally, with each thigh full natural length and exactly two legs. Keep the upper torso, tucked-back connected arms, head angle, scale and red/silver identity consistent with reference 1 and 2. References 3 and 4 show geometry of this motion on the monster's back: use them only to maintain abdomen support and head clearance, do NOT draw the monster or panels. Reference 5 defines character identity. Full isolated character, blue chest light, crisp cohesive pixel style, genuine transparent background. No text, grids, ground, glow, shadows, extra limbs or objects.
